data.title: Questions we hear a lot
data.lead: Short answers, with the full details in the documentation.

items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer: Yes. Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated; downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period.

items.question: What counts as a pageview?
items.answer: Every page load that reaches your site, including each page change in a single-page app. Bots and your own visits are filtered out.

items.question: Do I need a cookie banner?
items.answer: No. Tidepool sets no cookies and stores no personal data, so there is nothing visitors need to consent to.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: In data centres in Frankfurt and Amsterdam. Enterprise customers can choose a single region.

items.question: Can I export my data?
items.answer: Yes. Every report downloads as CSV, and the full raw data is available as a daily export.

items.question: Is there a discount for non-profits?
items.answer: Registered non-profits and open-source projects get the Team plan at half price. Write to us with a link to your organisation.
